name: The Elementalists: Winters Past
source:
Reunite with your Penderghast pals for some fun winter shenanigans, while trying to solve the mystery of the haunted chateau next door! Spooks, spells, and holiday cheer galore in The Elementalists: Winters Past!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Elementalists:_Winters_Past]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
与彭德加斯特的伙伴们重聚，一起享受冬日里的欢乐胡闹，同时尝试解开隔壁闹鬼城堡的谜团！《The Elementalists: Winters Past》里，幽灵、咒语与节日欢乐应有尽有！

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Elementalists:_Winters_Past]Choices Wikia[/url]]
